title: 连接科策 SCRM
description: 填入科策后台的 AppKey 与 AppSecret。凭证仅保存在本机 ~/.workbuddy 目录，不会上传云端。
description_en: Enter your Kece AppKey and AppSecret. Credentials are stored only on this device under ~/.workbuddy and are never uploaded to the cloud.

fields.label: AppKey
fields.placeholder: 科策后台 → 设置 → 系统对接 → API对接
fields.placeholder_en: Kece Console → Settings → System Integration → API Integration
fields.description: 企业 API 凭证中的 AppKey
fields.description_en: The AppKey from your enterprise API credentials.

fields.label: AppSecret
fields.placeholder: 与 AppKey 在同一页面，点击可复制
fields.placeholder_en: On the same page as the AppKey; click to copy
fields.description: 敏感凭证，仅保存在本机，请勿分享给他人
fields.description_en: Sensitive credential. Stored locally only; do not share it.

fields.label: 服务地址
fields.description: 正式环境保持默认；内部测试环境填测试域名
fields.description_en: Keep the default for production. Use your test domain for internal test environments.
